name: Monthly/Yearly Tabbed Archive & Post Filter, Grid Blocks
author: Akshar Addons

sections.description:
Archive Post Tabs plugin is used to show list and grid view of the archive posts with months and years tabs. This plugin allows to created unlimited widget and shortcodes for the home and sup-pages.

It’s fully responsive and customizable archive posts list and grid view using ajax load more functionality.

Get Support

Monthly archive tabs

[archivesposttab widget_title="Monthly Archives Tabs" date_format="month_year" number_of_post_display="8"]

Yearly archive tabs

[archivesposttab widget_title="Yearly Archives Tabs" date_format="year" number_of_post_display="8"]

Free Version Features

  • Customizable and responsive list and grid view.
  • Load more option for next archive posts pagination.
  • Multiple widget creation.
  • Custom settings to modify text and background color for the heading.
  • 3 responsive modern templates.
  • Supports posts grid view.

Premium Version Features

  • Load More button
  • Custom Post Type Support
  • Elementor & Gutenberg block support
  • Dynamic Shortcode creation
  • Custom settings available to hide or show post title, cart button, price, animation over image, post image, pagination, post short content and read more link.
  • Dynamic admin settings to change maximum width and height of the posts images.
  • There are three type of ajax based pagination available like load more products, next-previous links and simple numeric pagination.
  • Settings to choose any custom post type.
  • Search text field for the each tab.
  • Multiple shortcodes creation forms.
  • Supports posts list/grid views.
  • Admin settings for displaying post count with tabs.
  • Hide/show empty categories.
  • Month or year shorting and ordering.
  • Hide/Show certain category’s posts.
  • Open default month or year tab.
  • 10+ responsive templates.
  • Supports “All” label tab to load all tab’s posts.
  • RTL Support.
  • Allows to modify space between items in pixels.
  • Allows to hide/show author image and name.
  • View posted date with post title.
  • View comment count with post title.

sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, select the Archive Post Tabs ZIP file, and click Install Now. Alternatively, upload the extracted trunk plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and ensure the plugin files are inside /wp-content/plugins/trunk/ (the folder name may vary).
  2. Go to Plugins > Installed Plugins and click Activate for Archive Post Tabs.
  3. After activation, administrators are redirected once to the Archive Post Tabs settings/help page. You can return to it at any time by clicking Archive Post Tabs in the WordPress admin menu, or the Settings link beside the plugin name on the Installed Plugins page.
  4. On the settings page, review the shortcode example and the available attributes table. Use the Copy shortcode button to copy the example.
  5. To display the archive tabs in Gutenberg, edit a page or post, add a Shortcode block, and paste a shortcode such as one of these examples.

Monthly archive tabs

[archivesposttab widget_title="Monthly Archives" date_format="month_year" number_of_post_display="8"]

Yearly archive tabs

[archivesposttab widget_title="Yearly Archives" date_format="year" number_of_post_display="8"]
  1. Publish or update the page and view it on the front end. The shortcode displays published WordPress posts in archive tabs.
  2. For advanced features such as custom post type support and additional templates, use the Explore Pro Features link on the settings page.
sections.faq:
Can I use multiple widgets on the same page?

Yes, Supports multiple widgets.

Can I use multiple shortcode on the any pages?

Yes, Supports multiple shortcode from pro/premium version.

Can we override or change designing templates and style?

Yes, There is dynamic text and background color selection from admin panel.
